title: The Certification Limits of KS-Type Layer Relaxations: A Square-Root Ceiling and Its Breakdown
summary: A separable bilinear layer relaxation assigns a population cost to each layer and a nonpositive bilinear coupling to each pair of layers, then excludes a profile span whenever the relaxed minimum exceeds a reference value. We ask what a Kuznetsov-Sahinidis-type relaxation can certify at best. Let gamma = g(1) be the singleton-layer cost.
